sentences.text:
Later on :-
Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first bail application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.56/2024 registered at P.S - Industrial Area, Jaora, District - Ratlam (M.P.) for offences punishable under Section(s) 363, 376(2)(N) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. As per prosecution case, on 2.2.2024 father of the prosecutrix has lodged missing report stating that some unknown person enticing the prosecutrix abducted her.
On 11.6.2025 the prosecutrix was recovered by the Police.
Thereafter, she disclosed that she went with the applicant and solemnized marriage with the applicant.
During the aforesaid period the applicant made physical relationship with the prosecutrix.
Accordingly, a NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:37677 2 MCRC-58850-2025 case was registered against him.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that in fact present is a case of consent.
The applicant in her statement before the Court has stated in para 4 that she was 19 years of age at the time of incident.
It has also been stated that applicant and prosectrix have solemnized marriage on their own volition and they have a daughter out of their wedlock.
When she got information about the report lodged by her father against the applicant she returned to her home.
It is, thus submitted that even on the date of incident the prosecutrix was major and had solemnized marriage on her own volition.

Hence,
prays for enlargement of the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail, however, fairly concedes that at the time of incident prosecutrix was major.

5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 11.6.2025 and he has no criminal antecedents, this Court is of the view that the present applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

6. It is directed that applicant-Satyanarayan shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for his appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:37677 3 MCRC-58850-2025 8.
With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed off.
Cc as per rules.
